about.title: About GeoScape
about.subtitle: Designing landscapes and outdoor experiences with excellence.
about.our_story_dec: For over 14 years, GeoScape Co. has been at the forefront of providing an extensive range of urban furniture, play, sports, and fitness equipment, as well as wood plastic composites. We are dedicated to transforming outdoor spaces with products that embody creativity, innovation, and the highest standards of quality. Our partnerships with distinguished manufacturers from around the globe ensure that we deliver durability and sustainability in with Saudi Arabia's VISION 2030.
about.sustainability_desc: Eco-friendly solutions for a greener future
about.our_services_dec: At GeoScape, we offer a comprehensive suite of professional landscape services designed to meet the highest standards of quality. We leverage the best products available both in the Saudi Arabian and international markets to ensure excellence in every project. Our services include: Landscape Design: We create detailed 2D and 3D designs to bring your vision to life. Installation: Our team handles the complete installation process, guaranteeing the quality and longevity of our products and services. Maintenance Plans: We offer a variety of maintenance plans tailored to fit your specific needs, ensuring your landscape remains pristine year-round.
about.our_mission_dec: To be an integral part of our clients' daily lives by offering top-tier local services, delivering professional technological solutions, and fostering relationships based on trust and reliability.
about.our_commitment_dec: Quality: We are committed to providing the highest quality products and services. Our rigorous standards ensure that every project we undertake is executed to perfection. Innovation: We continuously seek out innovative solutions and cutting-edge technologies to stay ahead in the industry. Sustainability: We are dedicated to sustainable practices, ensuring that our work not only meets current needs but also preserves the environment for future generations.
about.our_products_dec: At GeoScape Co., we provide an extensive range of products to elevate and beautify outdoor environments:
about.urban_furniture_dec: Elegant and durable furniture solutions for both public and private.
about.play_equipment_dec: Safe and captivating play structures suitable for children of all ages.
about.sports_fitness_equipment_dec: Premium quality gear designed to encourage physical activity and well-being.
about.wood_plastic_composites_dec: Eco-friendly and versatile materials ideal for numerous applications.
about.company_profile_dec: For a detailed overview of our company, services, and products, please download our comprehensive Company Profile.

partners.geoscape_partners_dec: At GeoScape, we believe in the power of collaboration and building strong partnerships to enhance our services and offerings. We are proud to partner with some of the best in the industry to bring you top-quality products and services.
partners.benito_urban_dec:
We are delighted to partner with BENITO Urban, a leading international provider of urban furniture, playgrounds, and outdoor fitness solutions.

Renowned for their excellence in design, innovation, and sustainability, BENITO Urban transforms public spaces into vibrant, functional, and engaging environments. Their dedication to quality and long-term impact perfectly complements our vision, enabling us to deliver world-class solutions that enrich communities and promote healthier lifestyles.

partners.benito_commitment_dec: Innovation, quality, sustainability Together with BENITO Urban, we strive to create exceptional environments that enhance community well-being and foster a healthier, more active lifestyle. Our partnership ensures that we can offer you the best products and solutions to meet your needs.
partners.benito_explore: Explore our solutions and discover how our partnership with BENITO Urban can bring value to your projects. Visit website to learn more about their innovative products and exceptional services.
partners.prasada_agricultural_dec:
Prasada Agricultural is a globally recognized leader in agricultural greenhouse manufacturing, bringing over two decades of experience in developing innovative and sustainable growing solutions.

Renowned for its expertise in turnkey greenhouse projects, Prasada combines advanced technology, engineering excellence, and industry knowledge to deliver high-performance solutions tailored to modern agricultural needs. Operating in more than 70 countries, the company has established a trusted international reputation.
partners.prasada_commitment_dec: Together with Prasada Agricultural, we aim to empower smart agriculture, nurture green life, and help communities share a better life. Our collaboration ensures we can provide you with advanced greenhouse solutions to meet the evolving needs of modern agriculture.
partners.prasada_explore: Explore our solutions and discover how our partnership with Prasada Agricultural can benefit your projects. Visit website to learn more about their exceptional products, innovative solutions, and trusted services.
